# laya-go defend prompt v1 golden request

`request.json` is laya-go's `games/defend/prompt/testdata/v1_sample_request.json` (laya-go branch `defend`, commit `05a4741`). The contract test builds the same state from a fake bot: chainmail helmet and iron chestplate (8 armour), a shield in the off hand, a bow, an iron sword, 12 arrows in two stacks, a golden apple; a zombie at E2 N2 and a skeleton at W12 S4 (plus a far zombie and a cow, left out).

`decisions.jsonl`: 1000 situations from laya-go `games/defend/generate.Situations(7, 1000)` (seed 7) at laya-go commit `3a8fe4c` (branch `minecraft`), one row each: `state` (`prompt.State`), `questions` (`prompt.Questions`), `rules.Decide` written as the question options by `prompt.Want` (`action`, `target` as "<kind> <n>" or `none`, `weapon` or `none`), its `rule`, and `danger` (`Situation.Danger`). All 13 rules are exercised. They were written by a throwaway Go program importing laya-go through a `replace` directive (laya-go's tree untouched). bot/test/defend.test.ts checks the new bot's renderer, questions and rules against every row. The request.json above still equals laya-go `3a8fe4c`'s sample (normalised JSON compare, 2026-11-12).
